_comment: Copy ONE of the methods below into your AI client's mcp.json.
IMPORTANT: Start the RedVector backend (python -m redvector) FIRST before using Method 2 (SSE).
Method 1 (stdio) auto-starts everything via the launcher script.

_instructions: Step 2: Pull a model:                ollama pull llama3
Step 3: Start RedVector backend:     python -m redvector
Step 4: Start MCP with SSE:          python -m redvector.mcp.server --transport sse --mcp-port 8889
Step 5: Add this config to your AI client's mcp.json
